AR217
In Small Things Forgotten: Artifact Analysis
0.5 Credit
Designed to give
students
intensive training in the necessary methodologies of preparing and analyzing archaeological data from an excavation site, this course emphasizes methods of recording, preserving and reconstructing artefacts, and the ways and means of analyzing those objects.
Additional Course Information
Prerequisites
AR101
,
AR102
.
